## Finding primary sources

[Hansard](https://hansard.parliament.uk/)
: Debates in both Houses of Parliament, searchable back to 1803.

[The National Archives](https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/)
: Cabinet papers and government department records, mostly released under the twenty-year rule.

[Mass Observation](https://www.massobs.org.uk/)
: Diaries, surveys and reports on everyday life from 1937 onwards.

[Labour History Archive, People's History Museum](https://phm.org.uk/collections/archive-collections/)
: Records of the Labour Party and the wider labour movement.

[Conservative Party Archive, Bodleian Libraries](https://www.bodleian.ox.ac.uk/)
: Party organisation, research department and campaign material.

## Data for studying elections

[House of Commons Library](https://commonslibrary.parliament.uk/)
: Election results, turnout and constituency data, with briefing papers.

[British Election Study](https://www.britishelectionstudy.com/)
: Survey data on how and why people have voted, from 1964.
